name: shopify-storefront
description: Connect to Shopify's public Storefront and UCP catalog MCP servers. Browse products, manage shopping carts, and look up store policies — no authentication required.

connection.instructions: Enter your Shopify store's myshopify.com subdomain (e.g. `my-store` for `my-store.myshopify.com`). This enables product search via the UCP catalog, cart management, and store policy lookup — no sign-in required.

fields.name: SHOPIFY_SHOP_SUBDOMAIN
fields.label: Shop subdomain
fields.helpText: The subdomain of your Shopify store — the part before .myshopify.com. Used to build both the Storefront and UCP MCP server URLs.
